test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some L are G.

II. All M are L.

**Conclusion:**

I. All L are M

II. Some G are not M.

III. No M is G.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca4f8ce41fd5fe95e695e15ef39f7ce28316b6095c99d6afa72e98a9837d29fb.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All L are M → False (As All M are L so, All L are M is false)

II. Some G are not M → False (As Some L are G and All M are L so, Some G are not M is not definite)

III. No M is G → False (As Some L are G and All M are L so, No M is G is false)

∴ Here, All three conclusion I and II and III are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion follows".**
